messages:
Anya (PM): Quick sync — proposal for a lightweight 'experimental cohort' for new model onboards. Goal: catch regressions early, give select customers opt-in pinning, and validate cost/latency tradeoffs before full catalog entry. Thoughts?
Alex (Eng): Sounds good. Can we make it 2 weeks shadow + 2 weeks limited canary? Need to lock hardware tags so we don't accidentally schedule on tiny nodes. @infra-bot any objections? :eyes:
Infra-bot: Canary job template created: job/exp-cohort-canary v1. Trigger: tag=exp-cohort, regions: us-west-2/us-east-1. Will auto-notify on SLA/latency regressions.
Sam (Research): Benchmarking checklist suggestion: p95 latency target, quality eval on existing prompt set, and a token-cost delta threshold. Proposed numeric gates: p95 <= 120ms (baseline Llama-like), eval pass >= 0.92 ROC AUC, cost multiplier <= 1.25. Happy to own running these.
Marta (CS): From customer side — need a pin TTL policy + escape hatch. Enterprise customers ask for longer pins or contract changes. Can we make pin opt-in by tenant and default TTL 90 days? Also need clear comms for migration path.
Tara (Sales): +1 on opt-in. Recommend a short legal blurb for enterprise pins (one-paragraph) so AEs can offer it during POCs. Also request a migration checklist for customers who later want to unpin.
Alex (Eng): Draft cohort config (will iterate):
```
cohort: experimental
duration_days: 14
canary_window_days: 14
hardware_tags: [g4dn.xlarge, g5.xlarge]
benchmarks:
  latency_p95_ms: 120
  eval_pass_threshold: 0.92
  cost_multiplier_max: 1.25
pinning:
  tenant_opt_in: true
  default_ttl_days: 90
  escape_hatch: rollback-to-stable
```
Sam (Research): I want to add a small tokenization parity check: embed/response tokenization mismatch > 3% flags as failure. Also will add a tiny human-in-the-loop sample set for semantic-quality checks.
Marta (CS): Operational asks: 1) add per-tenant opt-out telemetry so we can measure adoption, 2) add a migration playbook with steps + recommended canary traffic ramp for customers who unpin.
Alex (Eng): Ops items noted. We should gate full catalog admission on: bench pass, infra stability (no >2 incidents in 14d), and docs + sales blurb. Who owns the final go/no-go? PM + Eng lead + Research sign-off?
Anya (PM): Yes — propose sign-off group = PM (me) + Eng lead (Alex) + Research (Sam) + CS rep (Marta). If any single owner flags a fail, we hold. Action items: Alex - iterate config and infra job; Sam - finalize bench suite and run baseline; Marta - draft migration playbook + comm blurb; Tara - legal one-liner via AE templates. I'll schedule a 30m sync next Tue to review initial results. :thumbsup:
Tara (Sales): Happy to draft the AE blurb, pinging legal now.
Alex (Eng): I'll drop the draft YAML into infra repo and add the canary dashboard. ETA EOD Friday.
Sam (Research): Starting bench runs today. Will post summary in this thread when done.
Marta (CS): I'll draft the migration checklist and add a customer-facing FAQ. Expect draft by Monday.
Anya (PM): Great — thanks everyone. If no blockers, we'll treat this as the default lightweight path for all non-pinned new models starting next quarter.
